Name: Dayswork
Author: Bindicle
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F5B942]Dayswork[/color][/b][/size]
[i]Hire an NPC farmhand who actually walks your farm and does the work.[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Description[/color][/b][/size]
Tired of doing all the farm work yourself? Build a [b]Farmhand Office[/b] at Robin's, hire a farmhand, and set up a contract for the chores you'd rather skip. Every morning, your farmhand spawns outside the office, [b]walks[/b] the farm (and the valley) doing the work you chose, delivers the output to your chests, and heads back to the office when the day's energy is spent.

Your farmhand works with [b]your[/b] progression: the best tools you've carried, plus your skills, professions and mastery, which shape drops, crop quality, wood and seeds. As you get better, so do they. Want more help? Build more offices: each one hires its own farmhand.

[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]What your farmhand can do[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Crops[/b] — water and harvest, pick fruit trees, and clear dead crops[/*]
[*][b]Manage Seasonal Crops[/b] — tell the farmhand what to plant each season; they buy the seeds automatically, or take them from the chest you pick. Flower groups can be held until their last day for your bee houses[/*]
[*][b]Wood Lots[/b] — draw a lot and pick a tree: the farmhand clears, plants and fertilizes it, then fells grown trees and replants from their seeds, or leaves them standing and collects seeds and moss. Tapped trees are left alone and their tappers emptied[/*]
[*][b]Valley Foraging[/b] — pick the maps, from Pelican Town to the Secret Woods (plus SVE's maps), and your farmhand forages them in the shortest order at your Foraging quality, shaking berry bushes and digging artifact and seed spots. Combine it with fishing in one trip[/*]
[*][b]Fishing[/b] — choose the waters and how long to fish each, with optional bait and tackle. Your farmhand casts with your best rod, follows bubbles, and brings back fish and treasure. Each spot shows what's biting today, and a farmhand can fish a spot you pick once the day's other work is done[/*]
[*][b]Manage Machines[/b] — collect finished output and reload machines from an input chest in any location[/*]
[*][b]Manage Fish Ponds[/b] — collect pond output every day[/*]
[*][b]Animal Care[/b] — feed, pet, milk, shear, collect products, and dig truffles[/*]
[*][b]Clearing & Fieldwork[/b] — cut trees, break rocks, pull weeds and cut grass, and earn you Foraging and Mining experience while they do[/*]
[*][b]Chores[/b] — harvest the farm cave (mushrooms or fruit bats), water pet bowls, and mine the farm quarry on the Hill-top and Four Corners farms (and SVE's Grandpa's and Frontier farms)[/*]
[*][b]Storage Organizing[/b] — after the day's other work, sort your farm's chests by include and exclude rules. Preview the moves first and get a summary afterwards[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Contracts your way[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Flexible work scope[/b] — draw separate zones for crop care and fieldwork, choose animal buildings, include or exclude the greenhouse[/*]
[*][b]Priority system[/b] — drag to reorder tasks; higher-priority work comes first[/*]
[*][b]Energy tiers[/b] — Half Day, Full Day or Overtime to balance cost against output[/*]
[*][b]One-time or recurring[/b] — pay up front for a single day's work, or set a recurring contract that charges each morning[/*]
[*][b]Smart deposits[/b] — items go to your chosen chests or the shipping bin, and nothing is ever lost, even if a chest is full[/*]
[*][b]Chests follow the work[/b] — move or pick up a chest your farmhand uses and its work follows. Name your chests and groups so menus are easy to read (Chests Anywhere names are picked up too)[/*]
[*][b]Nothing gets downgraded[/b] — quality, flavors (wines, roe, honey) and colors are kept exactly as if you'd picked them up yourself[/*]
[*][b]Festival days off[/b] — farmhands stay home on festivals; recurring contracts aren't charged, and one-time fees are refunded (configurable)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Make it yours[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Farmhands look like farmers[/b] — they walk, swing tools, milk, shear, fish and carry just like you, and wear real clothes. Design each one in a character creator, with presets, Randomize, or a copy of your own look[/*]
[*][b]Multiple offices[/b] — each with its own contract, farmhand, and harvest chest; farmhands share overlapping work instead of doing it twice[/*]
[*][b]Paintable office[/b] — repaint the Farmhand Office at Robin's, like a barn or coop[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
Dayswork fully supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Farmhands work SVE's farm expansion areas, forage SVE's maps, care for SVE animals, and path around SVE's farm layouts just like vanilla ones. No extra setup or patch required.

Lookup Anything and NPC Map Locations show each farmhand with their own look, and Chests Anywhere chest names are used in Dayswork's menus.

[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Multiplayer[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Co-op is supported[/b], including split-screen and separate wallets. Every player can build offices and hire farmhands, and fees, tools, progression, shipping, and experience all follow the office's owner, even while they're away. [b]Everyone must run the same Dayswork version.[/b] If a player without Dayswork, or on a different version, joins, every farmhand stays home until they leave (or the host can have them disconnected automatically in the config).

[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][i]Optional:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 1.16+ for in-game configuration[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install SMAPI[/b] — follow the setup instructions at [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url][/*]
[*][b]Download this mod[/b] — extract the [b]Dayswork[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b] directory[/*]
[*][b]Launch the game[/b] through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Upgrading from 2.x[/color][/b][/size]
Existing contracts carry over. The office's supply chest is retired and replaced by porch furniture: its contents move into the harvest chest, and anything that doesn't fit waits on the porch left of the door. Existing farmhands keep their colors as a matching preset. In co-op, every player must update to 3.0.

[size=4][b][color=#F5B942]Getting started[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Build a [b]Farmhand Office[/b] at Robin's[/*]
[*]Click the office to open the contract screen[/*]
[*]Pick the work you want done and where; choose an energy tier and schedule[/*]
[*]Hire, and your farmhand starts the next morning[/*]
[/list]
